column3: the exact published commit this package is built from, 40
lowercase hexadecimal digits. A branch is refused: a release
built from a moving ref is a release nobody can rebuild. These
directories carry no tag of their own — the Go module tags in
tools.tsv name Go modules and say nothing about the JavaScript
beside them — so the commit is what identifies them
